title: Split marked nodal action and trivial stabilizer dual graphs
statement:
Let $f:T	o S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $J$ a group with compatible actions $a_T,a_S$, and $m_1,\ldots,m_n:S	o T$ disjoint sections in the relative smooth locus [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Define the split marked-action condition as follows. First $f$ satisfies the rational-node-and-branches condition [def-sfb-quasi-split-nodal-fibres]. Every irreducible component of every residue-field fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre], with its reduced induced closed structure [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization], is geometrically irreducible over the residue field [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. For $g\in J$ fixing $y\in S$, $a_T(g)$ preserves each component of $T_y$ individually, fixes every nonsmooth point, and fixes every marked point $m_i(y)$. It also fixes both branches of every node: for the induced automorphism $b$ of $T_y$, the induced automorphism $c$ of its componentwise normalization fixes every point above each node. Equivalently this last condition is imposed for every pair of automorphisms $b,c$ satisfying $\iota_y\circ b=a_T(g)\circ\iota_y$ and $
u_y\circ c=b\circ
u_y$, where $\iota_y:T_y	o T$ and $
u_y:T_y^
u	o T_y$ are the canonical maps. The commuting squares determine these lifts uniquely, and the lifts exist by functoriality under isomorphisms. Components need not be smooth; self-nodes and an empty marking are allowed. Thus point stabilizers act trivially on vertices, edges, both ends, and marked legs of the geometric dual graph.

reviewed_lean.note: Every hypothesis and conclusion clause matches the node; f QC+QS follow from projectivity; the hscalar Spec.map(ρ g⁻¹) convention is consistent with Aut composition; empty D gives the unit ideal and reduces to smoothness of S₀; E' is the radical of the comap of vanishingIdeal B along r≫fst; components are determined by integral, incomparable C i; equations use the ordinary-stalk germ map, with an injective index into a regular system of parameters; IsRegularScheme and the IsHProjective implication are present. New def-sfb-split-marked-nodal-action: no duplicate (def-per-marked-split-nodal-tower needs smooth components); quasi-split plus geometrically irreducible components plus stabilizer fixing components, nodes, both normalization branches and marked points; the b/c lifts exist and b is unique, so not vacuous. Statements verbatim, 15 steps in the docstring, sorry only, lines ≤100, source and blueprint docstrings present. Advisories: H11 second reading is an author self-audit (dispatcher policy); two extra proof-only imports serve proof deps without lean records; maintainer: split + trivial-legs is stronger than the quasi-split data the galois-model citer supplies.
